title: Overwater Nipa Hut in El Nido
description: A breezy bamboo-and-nipa cottage right on the sand. Wake up to turquoise water, island-hop from the front steps and end the day with sunset over Bacuit Bay.

title: Jungle Pool Villa near Coron
description: Private villa surrounded by palms and limestone cliffs, with a lagoon-style pool. Close to Kayangan Lake and the best wreck dives in Palawan.

title: Cliffside Infinity Suite, Boracay
description: Perched above the sea with an infinity pool that melts into the horizon. Minutes from White Beach but far enough for quiet nights.

title: Heritage House with Pool in Vigan
description: A restored colonial-style home with wide verandas and capiz windows, a short calesa ride from Calle Crisologo.

title: Teak Lodge & Pool Deck, Panglao
description: Hardwood lodge with a big pool deck and loungers, a few steps from Alona Beach. Perfect base for Chocolate Hills and tarsier day trips.

title: Mountain A-Frame Cabin in Sagada
description: Cozy A-frame among the pines, with a fireplace for cold Cordillera nights and the sea of clouds a short hike away.

title: Tiny Red Cabin in Atok
description: A one-room tiny house on a flower-covered hill. Simple, quiet and made for slow mornings with Benguet coffee.

title: Modern Luxe Villa in Nasugbu
description: Glass-and-concrete villa with a lap pool, chef's kitchen and floor-to-ceiling windows. Two hours from Manila, a world away.

title: Architect's Design House, Tagaytay
description: Minimalist white house with a plunge pool and cool Tagaytay breeze. Great for a weekend of bulalo and Taal views.

title: Surf Deck Bungalow, Siargao
description: Sun deck with loungers facing the sea, board rack included. Ride to Cloud 9 in ten minutes.

title: Pine Forest Cottage near Baguio
description: Brick cottage in a quiet pine grove just outside Baguio. Fresh strawberries in the morning, bonfire at night.

title: Sunset Earth Home in Bukidnon
description: Off-grid wooden home in the highlands, built with local materials. Watch the sun drop behind Mt. Kitanglad.

title: Sky Glass House, Moalboal
description: A jaw-dropping glass villa with a rooftop deck and pool. Swim with the sardine run in the morning, stargaze at night.
